evals.prompt: Find all In Progress and On Hold tasks assigned to Noman. Show me what he's currently working on.
evals.expected_output: Claude resolves 'Noman' to user ID 64 from memory, maps 'In Progress'→7 and 'On Hold'→13 and 'Task'→1 from memory, runs the script with --assignee 64 --status 7,13 --type 1, and presents a table grouped by project.

evals.prompt: Show me all Epics and Features that are due before May 31, 2026 and haven't started yet (no start date, or start date in the future). Search across all projects.
evals.expected_output: Claude maps Epic→5 and Feature→4 from memory, runs with --type 5,4 --due-to 2026-05-31, presents results grouped by project with ⚠️ flags on items with missing start dates.

evals.prompt: Search for work package #57943 and also show me its child tasks.
